```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
```


```{r}
studies = read_rds("data/studies.rds")
countries = read_rds("data/countries.rds")
sponsors = read_rds("data/sponsors.rds")
conditions = read_rds("data/conditions.rds")
browse_conditions = read_rds("data/browse_conditions.rds")
browse_interventions = read_rds("data/browse_interventions.rds")
baseline_counts = read_rds("data/baseline_counts.rds")
eligibilities = read_rds("data/eligibilities.rds")
designs = read_rds("data/designs.rds")
```

# Visualizations

```{r}
# Number of unique studies per country
studies_by_country = countries |>
  semi_join(studies, by = "nct_id") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_studies))

# View top 20 countries
studies_by_country |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}

studies_by_country |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_studies,
    y = reorder(country, n_studies)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Countries With the Most Registered Clinical Studies",
    subtitle = "ClinicalTrials.gov / AACT",
    x = "Number of unique registered studies",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
studies_by_country_type = countries |>
  inner_join(
    studies |>
      select(nct_id, study_type),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) |>
  group_by(country, study_type) |>
  summarise(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identify top 20 countries overall
top_countries = studies_by_country |>
  slice_max(n_studies, n = 20) |>
  pull(country)

# Stacked bar chart
studies_by_country_type |>
  filter(country %in% top_countries) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n_studies,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(
      country, n_studies, .fun = sum
    ),
    fill = study_type
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Registered Clinical Studies by Country and Study Type",
    x = "Number of registered studies",
    y = "Country",
    fill = "Study Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Clinical Research Activity Over Time
change this after pulling bc we have both actual and estimated now...

```{r}
studies_by_year = studies |>
  mutate(year = year(start_date)) |>
  filter(between(year, 2015, 2025)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

studies_by_year |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_studies)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Clinical Research Activity Over Time",
    subtitle = "Registered studies with actual start dates, 2015–2025",
    x = "Study start year",
    y = "Number of studies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Trends in Registered Clinical Studies by Study Type

```{r}

studies_by_type_year = studies |>
  mutate(year = year(start_date)) |>
  filter(
    between(year, 2015, 2025),
    study_type %in% c("INTERVENTIONAL", "OBSERVATIONAL")
  ) |>
  group_by(year, study_type) |>
  summarize(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

studies_by_type_year |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = n_studies,
    color = study_type
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Trends in Registered Clinical Studies by Study Type",
    x = "Study start year",
    y = "Number of studies",
    color = "Study type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Study Type Composition Over Time

```{r}

studies_by_type_year |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n_studies / sum(n_studies)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = proportion,
    fill = study_type
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025) +
  labs(
    title = "Study Type Composition Over Time",
    x = "Study start year",
    y = "Percentage of registered studies",
    fill = "Study type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}

# Count studies initiated between 2015 and 2025
studies_by_country = countries |>
  inner_join(
    studies |>
      mutate(year = year(start_date)) |>
      filter(between(year, 2015, 2025)) |>
      select(nct_id),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  group_by(country_iso3) |>
  summarize(
    n_studies = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}

# Import country boundaries
world = ne_countries(
  scale = "small",
  returnclass = "sf"
) |>
  filter(admin != "Antarctica") |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = if_else(
      iso_a3 == "-99",
      adm0_a3,
      iso_a3
    )
  )

# Join study counts to map
world_studies = world |>
  left_join(
    studies_by_country,
    by = "country_iso3"
  )

# Plot
world_studies |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = n_studies)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    labels = scales::comma,
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Number of studies"
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Distribution of Registered Clinical Studies",
    subtitle = "Studies initiated between 2015 and 2025",
    caption = "Source: ClinicalTrials.gov / AACT"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r}
studies_by_country |>
  plot_ly(
    type = "choropleth",
    locations = ~country_iso3,
    z = ~n_studies,
    text = ~paste0(
      country_iso3,
      "<br>Registered studies: ",
      scales::comma(n_studies)
    ),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    colorscale = "Viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Global Distribution of Registered Clinical Studies",
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    )
  )
```


```{r}

map_year = 2023

# Clean country names in AACT
countries_clean = countries |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    ),
    country_iso3 = if_else(
      country == "Serbia and Montenegro",
      NA_character_,
      country_iso3
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  distinct(nct_id, country, country_iso3)

# Count unique studies in the selected year
trial_counts = trials_df |>
  filter(start_year == map_year) |>
  select(nct_id) |>
  inner_join(countries_clean, by = "nct_id") |>
  group_by(country, country_iso3) |>
  summarise(
    n_trials = n_distinct(nct_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pull one population value per country for the selected year
pop_df = daly_df |>
  filter(year == map_year) |>
  distinct(country, pop_thousands) |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    ),
    country_iso3 = if_else(
      country == "Serbia and Montenegro",
      NA_character_,
      country_iso3
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso3), !is.na(pop_thousands), pop_thousands > 0)

# Merge trial counts with population
trial_density = trial_counts |>
  inner_join(
    pop_df |>
      select(country_iso3, pop_thousands),
    by = "country_iso3"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    studies_per_million = n_trials / pop_thousands * 1000
  )

trial_density |>
  arrange(desc(studies_per_million)) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = trial_density,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~country_iso3,
  locationmode = "ISO-3",
  z = ~studies_per_million,
  text = ~paste0(
    country,
    "<br>Trials: ", comma(n_trials),
    "<br>Population (thousands): ", comma(pop_thousands),
    "<br>Trials per million: ", round(studies_per_million, 2)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "Viridis"
) |>
  layout(
    title = paste(
      "Registered Clinical Studies per Million Population,",
      map_year
    ),
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    )
  )
```

log scale:

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = trial_density,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~country_iso3,
  locationmode = "ISO-3",
  z = ~log10(studies_per_million + 0.01),
  text = ~paste0(
    country,
    "<br>Trials: ", comma(n_trials),
    "<br>Population (thousands): ", comma(pop_thousands),
    "<br>Trials per million: ", round(studies_per_million, 2)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "Viridis"
) |>
  layout(
    title = paste(
      "Registered Clinical Studies per Million Population (log scale),",
      map_year
    ),
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    )
  )
```
